definition: Daniela Amodei (born 1987) is an American entrepreneur and the president of Anthropic, an artificial intelligence (AI) company known for its Claude series of large language models.
details: She co-founded Anthropic in 2021 with her brother Dario Amodei. Prior to her work at Anthropic, she was the vice president of safety and policy at OpenAI.

explainer.lead: Daniela Amodei is an American entrepreneur (born 1987). Her work spans artificial intelligence.

contributions.name: She was the vice president of safety and policy there, but left in 2020 to co-found Anthropic with her brother Dario Amodei.
